source: Verified live app bundle and versioned browser assets
observerNote: Corrected audit observer; not the older observer shipped with 1.49. Hidden identities cannot affect candidate choices. Profile matches the live focused profile.
visibility: Non-exactly-covered face-up faces and takeable face-down faces are treated as known. Free peeks are idealised; blocked-tap x-ray and count-based deduction are not simulated.
definition: Unknown-partner selection: selected single whose matching face is neither in the tray nor among known remaining tiles. It is not equivalent to an unavoidable guess. A zero count is not a proof of deduction-only play.
